### Summary of What Was Verified

1. **Commands Executed**:
   - `npm test`: Passed (1 passing test), but verified that it only exercises an unused utility function ([`formatMinor`](file:///C:/tmp/agent-skills-eval-9zeC8F/workspace/src/format.js#L1-L6)), leaving the API endpoints ([`src/app.js`](file:///C:/tmp/agent-skills-eval-9zeC8F/workspace/src/app.js)) and database layer ([`src/orders.js`](file:///C:/tmp/agent-skills-eval-9zeC8F/workspace/src/orders.js)) completely untested.
   - `npm audit`: Failed with `ENOLOCK` due to the absence of a `package-lock.json` lockfile.
   - Suite inspection tools: `check-migrations` (flagged destructive DDL), `check-operability` (flagged missing health endpoints and operations guide), `check-backend` (confirmed parameterized queries with no client secrets), and `check-organization` / `check-smells` (confirmed clean module structure without circular dependencies).

2. **Critical & High-Risk Defects Identified**:
   - **Destructive DDL in Nightly Workflow**: [`migrations/0004_orders_retention.sql`](file:///C:/tmp/agent-skills-eval-9zeC8F/workspace/migrations/0004_orders_retention.sql#L5) runs `ALTER TABLE orders DROP COLUMN legacy_reference;` inside a nightly scheduled GitHub Actions job ([`.github/workflows/retention.yml`](file:///C:/tmp/agent-skills-eval-9zeC8F/workspace/.github/workflows/retention.yml#L16)), which permanently destroys column data and will fail on subsequent nightly executions.
   - **Disabled Backup Verification**: [`scripts/restore-check.sh`](file:///C:/tmp/agent-skills-eval-9zeC8F/workspace/scripts/restore-check.sh#L4) is hardcoded to `exit 0`, leaving backup restoration untested.
   - **Unhandled Rejections in Express 4**: Neither [`app.get('/orders')`](file:///C:/tmp/agent-skills-eval-9zeC8F/workspace/src/app.js#L7) nor [`app.post('/orders')`](file:///C:/tmp/agent-skills-eval-9zeC8F/workspace/src/app.js#L8-L13) catches async errors, risking process termination or hung requests upon database errors.
   - **Unhandled Idle Pool Errors**: [`src/orders.js`](file:///C:/tmp/agent-skills-eval-9zeC8F/workspace/src/orders.js#L3) does not register an error listener on `pg.Pool`.
   - **Missing Validation & Unbounded Query**: `GET /orders` does not validate `customerId` (passing `undefined` into PostgreSQL parameter binding), and queries lack pagination (`LIMIT`).
   - **Missing Platform Primitives**: No `/healthz` or `/readyz` probes and no `SIGTERM`/`SIGINT` graceful connection drainage.
